pr.title: Add job to re-replicate updated workspaces
pr.author: example-author

findings.finding: Missing parameter validation returns 500 instead of 400
findings.impact: Clients that omit the parameter receive a server error instead of a validation response.
findings.evidence: request.GET['since'] accessed with bracket notation — raises KeyError (500) when absent
findings.suggestion: Use request.GET.get('since') and return 400 if None

alternatives.trade_off: Simple, no framework overhead, but manual per-parameter

alternatives.approach: Use DRF serializer validation with BooleanField(required=True)
alternatives.trade_off: DRF handles 400 automatically, but adds serializer layer for simple params

findings.finding: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
findings.evidence: while True: retry without sleep or max_retries
findings.suggestion: Add exponential backoff and max retry count
